newsitem.title: USA: Chromcraft 1996 Q3 order rate behind 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chromcraft 1996 Q3 order rate behind 1995.

text.p: Chromcraft Revington Inc said Thursday its order rate for the third quarter 1996 was slightly below last year.

"Our incoming order rate for the third quarter was slightly below last year's period and order backlog at quarter end was at approximately the same level from a year ago," Michael Thomas, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
The company reported net earnings of $0.59 a share versus $0.50 last year.

Chromcraft Revington said its operating margin increased over last year's as a result of more favorable product sales mix and higher sales volume. It reported 1996 third quarter sales of $40.79 million versus $39.16 the previous year.
Chromcraft Revington provides casual dining and commercial furniture.
